title: Magical Night Dreams: Cotton Boomerang
native_title: マジカル・ナイト・ドリームス コットン・ブーメラン
overview:
This Time, Run Wild as a Team!

The second slapstick battle starring a chaotic duo of witch girls!!

This horizontally scrolling shooter is a remixed take on Cotton 2, with new characters, enemies and stage layouts. Pick a team of three from a roster that includes several versions of Cotton and Appli plus their companions Silk and Needle. Each has a magical element and shot pattern of their own, and when your active character is hit, the next one in line takes over.

Charge up elemental dragons, grab enemies to use as shields or throw them, and seal foes in magic bubbles with command shots to set off chain reactions for big bonuses. Swap characters on the fly to clear the screen, a limited number of times.

- 1 or 2 players simultaneously
- Four difficulty levels, adjustable team size and Free Play
- Gallery mode with artwork, and an unlockable Training mode

今度はチームで大暴れ！

ハチャメチャ魔女っ娘2人組みが繰り広げるスチャラカバトル第2弾！！
